title: fix(types,plugin-form)!: close FormField's open index signature; a form-view field's immutable locks the control on edit
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoGLEEchZXiDquUn9Vikz3oJ)_

Fixes #25923

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/**` page or docs page teaches `FormField` or its index signature (`grep -rn FormField skills/` is empty); the closed-face rule `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` already states for node types now holds for `FormField` too, and the spec's own `immutable` description ("editable on create, locked once the record exists") is what the renderer now does.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`@object-ui/types` 的 `FormField` 去掉了 `[key: string]: any` 开放索引签名，拼错或未声明的键在 TS 里直接报错；表单视图字段的 `immutable: true` 现在真的生效：编辑已有记录时该控件锁定，新建时仍可编辑。
- 为什么改：开放签名让拼写错误和宿主私写的键（如 `group`）都能静默通过；`immutable` 以前只是被抄到运行时字段上，没有任何渲染器读它，编辑表单里照样能改。这是本卡最后两项（席位裁决 A 与 immutable 跟进）。
- 风险与回滚：仅编译期收窄，运行时只多了一处行为（编辑模式下 immutable 字段禁用）；zod 镜像和严格授权面不变，spec 的接受集合不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.ts`（immutable 那一行）、`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/fieldGroups.ts`（两个本地交接类型）、`ui/packages/types/src/form.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.spec-parity.test.ts packages/types/src/__tests__/form-field-closed-face-25923.test.ts`，预期全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**`FormField` is a closed authoring face** (seat ruling 6412606977, letter A). `ui/packages/types/src/form.ts` drops `[key: string]: any` from `FormField`. Every declared member is unchanged. The zod mirror `FormFieldSchema` and the strict face `StrictAnyComponentSchema` are unchanged: they already refused undeclared keys. The readers the drop broke are fixed by declaring each key where its producer and reader live (ui `AGENTS.md` #0.1), never with a cast to `any` or `Record<string, unknown>`:

- **`@object-ui/core`** `FieldWithDeclaredDefault` (the parameter type of `isServerOwnedValue`) drops its own `[key: string]: unknown`. An interface without an index signature is not assignable to a type that has one, so every `FormField` call site of `isServerOwnedValue` broke on it: the 5 in components `form.tsx` and the 1 in plugin-form `WizardForm.tsx` measured on 2026-10-26 clear with this one change. The 2 plugin-grid errors measured then do not reproduce: `ObjectGrid.tsx` no longer imports `FormField` on today's `main`. Its test's bare `{ name: 'title' }` literal is now a typed `FormField` value.
- **`@object-ui/components`** `form.tsx`: the field's raw metadata carrier is typed `Record<string, unknown> | FormField` (the stashed object field, else the field config itself, which is what the code already did) on `RenderFieldProps.field`, `nativeNumberStep` and `dependentLookupParents`, instead of converting the config through the signature.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-form`**: `group`, which the host copies from the object field and `deriveFieldGroupSections` reads back, is typed on a package-local `FormFieldWithGroup` (`fieldGroups.ts`). `ObjectForm`'s generated field and `buildFlatFields` write it through that type. The section-divider row's `collapsible` / `collapsed` / `onToggle` are typed on a module-local `SectionDividerRow`, which replaces a `Record<string, unknown>` row cast to `FormField` and an `as unknown as FormField` gate row. `SectionDividerSource.visibleWhen` is `FormField['visibleWhen']`, not `unknown`.

**The immutable follow-up** (the work-item-4 landing record 6448239783: "`immutable` is declared on the mirror but not rendered by objectui (declared ≠ enforced). Render it, or record a refusal."). It is rendered. `normalizeSectionField` writes a form-view field's `immutable: true` as `disabled` when the form edits an existing record (`isCreateFormMode` false, the same create-mode question `required` asks there). A create form leaves it editable. The old pass-through copy to a runtime `immutable` key that no renderer read is gone. The `zod-mirror-parity` census row moves from `carried, not rendered` to `translated`.

**Spec accept sets:** none moves. The diff touches no `packages/spec` path and no `*.zod.ts`. The objectui zod faces are byte-identical, so `objectui validate` and the strict face judge every document as before. Only TypeScript consumers that wrote an undeclared key on a fresh `FormField` literal see a change, from their own compiler.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/form-field-closed-face-25923.test.ts`: fresh-literal `@ts-expect-error` rows for a misspelled key (`labell`) and a host-written key (`group`), plus the declared spelling compiling. Reverse check: with the signature put back, `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` reds both rows with TS2578 (unused directive); restored from `HEAD`, empty `git diff HEAD`.
- `sectionFields.spec-parity.test.ts` `immutable` row: an edit form (`mode: 'edit'`, `recordId`) draws it disabled with no `immutable` key carried; a create form leaves it enabled.
- `flatFields.test.ts` parity pin spreads both producers into plain records instead of casting a `FormField` to `Record<string, unknown>`.

## Acceptance notes

- `keyField`, `disclosure` and `precision` are still copied by `normalizeSectionField` onto the runtime field through its `any`-typed base, with no reader (the census rows say so). They are not on `FormField` and this PR does not put them there, since declaring keys no renderer reads would advertise them. The copy is a deliberate ADR-0007 pass-through in the mapper's own comment. Whether to keep carrying them or drop the copy is left to the seat.
- The section-divider branch of `form.tsx` reads its row through `fieldProps as any`, as before. This PR types the producer side only.
